{{Quote|Archer, this is Vee Prime. Spray a pattern of torps back toward the baby, we have a whole squad cutting out to go after him.|Vibroaxe Prime during the [[Battle of Kuat (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Kuat]]|<ref name="if" />}}
This '''Vibroaxe Squadron pilot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] and the leader of [[Vibroaxe Squadron]].

==History==
{{Quote|Yes, you did! My fleet would have fared better against Y-wings and X-wings. We did simulator training against them that we could have spent against simulated TIEs. That was lost time. I’ve suffered eighty percent vehicle losses, nearly fifty percent pilot losses!|Vibroaxe Prime to Melvar|<ref name="if" />|}}
Originally a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group, [[Vibroaxe Squadron]] was hired by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] to participate in a mission. Prime's unit suffered heavy losses during Zsinj's [[Battle of Kuat (Hunt for Zsinj)|raid]] on [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]; over 80 percent vehicle losses and 50 percent personnel losses. After the battle, he was infuriated with Zsinj because he led them to believe they were going to attack [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Prime claimed that instead of training against [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wings]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] in [[Flight simulator/Legends|simulators]], he could have spent the time he had in [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. He demanded to be paid in material funds, not just [[Datacard/Legends|datacards]] with account numbers even after Zsinj told him he would receive half of what was inside of the accounts the [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]] led to.<ref name="if" />
